messages:
lee: FYI noticed a quota attribution spike to `legacy-route` starting around 03:10 UTC. only started after we rolled TS client 1.12.0 to canary. anyone tracking header encoding changes?

mira: interesting. we shipped a compact-route header earlier this week in the ts client to reduce token overhead. what's the observed pattern? full logs?

lee: console shows tenant `acme` has 18% of requests attributed to legacy-route instead of the expected service-route. small SQL snippet attached from quota ledger: 
```sql
select route, count(1) from usage where tenant='acme' and ts > '2024-04-01' group by route;
-- legacy-route 1800
-- service-route 7600
```

alex: could be parsing fallback: server sees unknown header shape and falls back to default attribution. do we have the header samples?

lee: captured request header: `x-redwood-route: v2|svc=service-route;ver=2` from SDK 1.11. new one: `x-rd-route: svc=service-route;f=c` from 1.12 (shorter name + compact kv). server side should accept both but maybe router normalizer missed alias.

sam: we added alias support in the router but only for `x-redwood-route` and `x-redwood-route-v2`. looks like `x-rd-route` is new and unrecognized. ts PR shortened header name to save bytes, didn't coordinate with platform. my bad.

devex-bot: reminder: header name changes are breaking for attribution unless we maintain server compatibility. best practice: add new header in parallel, keep old one until server rollout complete, and include a feature flag.

mira: ok immediate mitigation: patch TS client to send both headers for now, and issue a platform patch to accept `x-rd-route` as alias. we should also mark telemetry event `sdk.header.alias_seen` so we can track clients still using the short header.

alex: agree. ops ask: add console dashboard that maps `sdk.header.alias_seen` by release so CS can contact customers. also need to correct quota ledger for misattributed consumption — if possible backfill for last 4 hours.

console-bot: created dashboard panel: https://console.redwood.internal/d/quota/header-alias. added alert if alias > 0.5% of tenant traffic.

lee: for backfill, infra: can we run a job to reparse logs and remap route for the affected window? will need to ensure idempotency.

mira: patch plan: 
- ts: revert to dual header write + telemetry event + release patch 1.12.1 (ETA: 4h)
- py/go: audit for similar optimization PRs and ensure parity (ETA: 1d)
- platform: accept `x-rd-route` alias in normalizer + one-off backfill job (ETA: 6h for alias, 12h for backfill)

sam: creating TS PR now. I'll add e2e that verifies both headers and server normalizer behavior. also add opt-in flag `X_REDWOOD_ROUTE_COMPACT=1` environment variable to enable compact-only in future major.

alex: release plan: patch canary 1% traffic after ts patch, monitor `legacy-route` metric and new `sdk.header.alias_seen`. if stable, roll to 10% then 100%. notify CS.

devex-bot: action items: [lee] confirm tenant list for targeted backfill; [sam] open ts dual-header PR + changelog; [mira] coordinate py/go audit; [alex] schedule dashboard alert and CS comms; [infra] run backfill job and confirm quota adjustments.

lee: I'll DM product to confirm impacted tenants. thanks all, want to avoid customers getting surprised bills.

mira: note for release notes: call this out as bandwidth optimization rollback and mention how to opt-in later with env var. will also add an RFC link for header aliasing policy.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ts-sdk/pull/487. adding test harness now.

ale x: thanks, taking dashboard + ops. will coordinate canary with release-war-room.

lee: closing loop: after backfill matched expected totals, we'll close incident. filing short postmortem to capture process gap (header name change without platform sync). :memo:
